purpose: Metadata-first admission protocol for independent external validation of frozen Lumen. Not an evaluation or new external-validation claim.
freeze_stage: Before acquiring or opening any independent participant-level outcomes. Published aggregate descriptions may be read only for dataset eligibility.
admission_criteria: Original independently collected patients with source institution, dates and sampling documented; no Z-Alizadeh 303/UCI411/UCI412/mirror/synthetic/resampled overlap.
Public authorized patient-level data with explicit reusable license or data-use authority, bounded acquisition under 20 MB, no private credentials or paid services.

All 55 Lumen clinical inputs must be available with verified source semantics, units, category definitions, measurement timing and outcome-independent harmonization. Missingness in measured inputs can be handled by the frozen imputer only under a documented missingness policy; an absent entire group cannot be manufactured or imputed to claim validation.

Patient-level invasive angiography Cath CAD and separate LAD/LCX/RCA stenosis labels must match the original >=50% diameter-narrowing endpoint; different modalities, outcomes or aggregate vessel counts cannot silently substitute. Original target cutoff/boundary definitions must be verified.

Provenance must rule out overlap with original source cohort; overlap check may use public development feature fingerprints only under a separately reviewed policy and must not open existing 61-record holdout.
No model, calibration, threshold, profile selection, fit or hyperparameter change. No rescoring existing 61-record holdout.

Freeze a source-specific codebook and harmonization mapping, cohort inclusion/exclusion rules, outcome-blinding mechanism, and exact evaluation plan before reading participant-level labels. Obtain parent authorization before scoring.

evaluation_if_admitted.primary_models: artifacts/final_models.json full 55 inputs, all four targets
evaluation_if_admitted.secondary_profiles: None unless a distinct source-specific protocol is frozen before labels; reduced-profile models cannot substitute for a missing full-input external validation.
evaluation_if_admitted.metrics: Per-target n and prevalence, AUROC, AUPRC with prevalence baseline, Brier, log loss, calibration intercept/slope and reliability table; frozen threshold confusion counts, accuracy, precision, recall, specificity and F1; fixed-0.5 comparison clearly secondary.
evaluation_if_admitted.uncertainty: Patient-level bootstrap using one shared resample across all targets, 1000 resamples; conditional on fixed models and thresholds; undefined metrics reported transparently.
evaluation_if_admitted.no_tuning: No threshold, calibration or model adaptation. Report all four outcomes and dataset exclusions, including disappointing results.
evaluation_if_admitted.interpretation: External retrospective validation only if admission criteria are met; no clinical-use or prospective claim.

current_status: Metadata research in progress; no qualifying independent participant-level data acquired; no predictions made.
